notes.title: VIGILANCE - Upcoming Survival Horror Game (Teaser Release)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-Eie4ttiKFI;full][/previewyoutube]I have finally released a brand new teaser of my upcoming survival horror game, I am going to be trying my best to get this game released soon at the highest standards possible.

This game is a survival horror game (not in any way like LIDAR Survival), with new features and gameplay that will be unique to the horror game franchise.

Note:
- This is not the only map in the game there will be several and this one is showcased as it is fully finished and ready to show off,
- I will be uploading more videos on this game as well as some gameplay reveals in the future (possibly development logs),
- Multiplayer (PVP and/or Co-op) is planned at some point, either on launch or as updates progress.

I am heavily dedicated on creating this game and will try my best to get it out as soon as possible at the quality I see it ready as, many features will get added and I'm open to suggestions if anyone feels like leaving them.

notes.title: MORE ACHIEVEMENTS, SECRETS, BUG FIXES!
notes.content:
- Added brand new achievements to the game

- Fixed some gun skin graphical issues

- Chance to get an unexpected surprise when sent to the menu

Thank you for playing I would very much appreciate it if you could all possibly leave a review as it really helps this game grow and means a lot to me ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: UPDATES WILL CONTINUE!!!
notes.content:
Going to start working on future updates, university as well as personal life might slow it down but I have big plans for this game as well as future games I will be working on,

Some ideas I have are things such as: 
- Story Mode (currently making map), 
- Multiplayer (one of the last things that will be added to make it properly when the game is finished), 
- VR Support (will be added possibly before multiplayer as horror games in VR when done properly, are very good).

Thank you for sticking by ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: UPDATE DETAILS (Story Mode in Progress)...
notes.content:
Next update will take a longer time to release, currently working on story mode which will take some time to make cutscenes, the map itself as well as more enemies for the game. I promise the wait will be worth it!

Also I am going on holiday soon which will also delay it slightly not to mention university. Thanks for sticking by ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: ACHIEVEMENTS and SKINS!
notes.content:
- Made Sonar Scanner faster (helping the player to detect enemies better)

- Fixed green dots sometimes not showing on the scanner (more accurate)

- Added an Inventory Section to the game

- Added achievements to the game you can unlock

- Added weapon skins (most of which can be unlocked with the achievements)

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE - New Levels, Enemy Re-made + Many More Changes!
notes.content:
- Added a brand new (invisible) enemy to the game, can be found in later levels,

- Complete remodel of the main enemy (new animations and model for each level),

- 5 New levels and mechanics added to the game and older levels,

- Added purgatory mechanic to the game (second life),

- Fixed enemies occasionally ignoring the player,

- Fixed enemies being able to see the player through the walls,

- Stopped enemies getting to the player before you leave spawn.

notes.title: Many Changes: New Leveling System and Campaign / Story Mode Coming Soon!
notes.content:
- Changed level systems completely, added a book you can navigate through with all the levels, allowing you to play each one with animations for each levels select,

- When pressing "New Game", you will now be given a warning before resetting your game data,

- Campaign section has been added as coming soon and will be ready in the near future,

- Added a skip button to the intro cutscene,

- Shortened the collection point timer from 3:30 to 1:30 minutes,

- Gun movement isn't as slow and follows the camera faster than before.

- Beating a level will no longer take you back to the main menu, you will be sent back to the level select to make it more convenient for the player.

Make sure to keep up to date with these updates, I will be working on this game every week to make sure more levels and lots of changes get released for players to have a better experience, if you haven't already, a review would very much be appreciated thank you!

notes.title: Bug Fixes: Player Movement and Survival Level Bug
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug involving the player to permanently bug the character to an unplayable state requiring a restart the level.

- Fixed the bug in the first survival level allowing the player to wait right next to the door for the timer to run out.
